response.justification: Bogdan has solid software engineering credentials with 15+ years of experience and entrepreneurial background, but critically lacks the AI/ML expertise essential for this strategic principal engineer role. He holds no advanced degree in AI, has no demonstrated AI products or platforms, and his current AI exposure is very recent (April 2025) and infrastructure-focused. Additionally, his staff-level IC position and absence of director-level strategic leadership experience do not align with the principal-level role requirement.
strengths: 15+ years of proven software engineering expertise across diverse platforms with strong technical craftsmanship and best practices
Entrepreneurial experience as GISCollective founder and through multiple early-stage companies demonstrates innovation and opportunity identification
Recent work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq shows emerging engagement with AI technologies
concerns: No formal AI/ML education or demonstrated products/platforms built with AI; expertise appears limited to very recent infrastructure tooling exposure
Staff-level position with no evident director-level strategic leadership, team management, or organizational decision-making experience
Limited demonstrated cloud and AI platform expertise; mentions of AWS and Kubernetes are minimal and lack the depth required for strategic advisory work
